fact: On 23 January 2025 the State Department for Social Protection said all Inua Jamii beneficiaries were being migrated to the e-Citizen M-Pesa payment platform from the January 2025 disbursement, with Safaricom lines required to match the ID card.
title: Nationwide roll out of Inua Jamii programme payment through mobile money agents
publisher: State Department for Social Protection and Senior Citizen Affairs, Kenya
